text: Directives reference: modify lines (#node, #page:, #slot:, #asset:, #export:, #document), structural directives (delete, parent, clone, replace, before/after), reconcile(<container>) + subtree, ds() parsed but not lowered (LUMD0700), undo/redo need a history adapter.
These are how you change an existing scene surgically … a diagnostic that names a node should be fixed with one of these, not a full rewrite.

Do target the failing node with a #id modify, a delete/parent, or a scoped apply_structured_edit. Do NOT re-emit page … or re-declare existing node ids — that is a repair failure (LUMA0200 / duplicate id).

For a precise, checked edit on a named node, prefer the tool apply_structured_edit with a scope over hand-writing DSL — it fails closed if the edit would touch anything outside the named target. See skills/repair-design and skills/tools.
note: BROKEN CROSS-REFERENCE: neither repair-design nor tools mentions apply_structured_edit; repair-design says to use compile_dsl_block modify lines.
